# Which of these resources is your terraform apply about to destroy?

> Paste a Terraform plan JSON to see what an apply destroys or replaces, with a loud flag when a database, bucket or DNS record is hit. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/terraform-plan-blast-radius-check/)

- [Why a Terraform replace destroys data, and why the plan won't always say which attribute forced it](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/terraform-plan-blast-radius-check/why-terraform-replace-destroys-data.html)
